annotations.text:
Click the role buttons in the header — Director, Brisbane manager, Townsville manager, Client.
Each role re-filters the whole board. A manager never receives another branch's rows; a client sees only their own file.

Changed from the 14 Aug version:
1. The client view now OPENS on what the client owes us — dormancy is the practice's real pain (D-34).
2. Section 56 deadlines have their own card. They outrank everything else on the board.
3. No predicted decision date, anywhere. Yale does not control Department processing times.

Clients are on phones; staff are at desks.
One action pinned at the bottom, 48px targets, no fake status bar.
Toggle the "complete" tweak to see the state after everything arrives.
